text:
Priya: heads-up — bringing up rnk-7b-v2 with int4 PTQ on the short-query cohort. seeing a notable MRR drop vs fp16 (NDCG small). anyone recall similar short-query sensitivity?
Sam: can you paste the eval command + cohort definition? and confirm tokenizer & preprocess parity.
Priya: eval command:
```
./tools/eval_rerank --model rnk-7b-v2 --quant int4 --cohort cohorts/short_queries.json --topk 10 --seed 42
```
cohort = queries <= 5 tokens, mostly navigational. preprocessing: html-strip -> whitespace collapse -> lowercase. note: last run we changed snip_length from 512 -> 256 in the harness.
Ben: do you have per-length breakdown? int4 often compresses score dynamics for short queries; could blow up MRR.
Priya: quick paste of current numbers (small sample run):
fp16: NDCG@10 0.3418, MRR 0.1976
int4: NDCG@10 0.3349, MRR 0.1498
short (<=5 toks) MRR: fp16 0.183 -> int4 0.112
Priya: weird part is NDCG barely changed but MRR tanked — suggests top-1 ordering flips more than rank-wise quality shift.
Carmen: that matches a reorder issue. that snip_length -> 256 could change which passage is top for long docs. also tokenizer version drift (tok v1 -> v2) will shift boundaries and affect candidate scoring ties.
Jorge: are we deduping by doc_id or by normalized_text? if dedupe differs between runs it can remove/keep top hits and change MRR a lot.
Priya: good call — previous fp16 run deduped by doc_id, current harness run used dedupe=textnorm due to a config refactor. i'll rerun with identical dedupe & snip_length to isolate quantization.
eval-bot: snapshot uploaded -> s3://redwood-evals/rnk7b/int4-shortprobe/2100123456 (logs + per-query dumps) :white_check_mark:
Sam: if repro holds after matching preprocess, next steps: dump logits for topk for 20 failing queries, check score spread and tie flips. also try hybrid: score top5 in fp16, re-rank in int4 (or vice versa) to see where error introduced.
Ben: also check embed scale/rescale in the scoring head — quantized weight scale can bias dot products.
Priya: running a strict parity run now (snip_length=512, dedupe=doc_id, tokenizer=tok-v2) — will post new numbers and logits dump. ETA ~1h :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Carmen: ping me when done, i'll run a small script to compute how many queries changed top1 and whether those flips come from candidate trimming vs score compression.
Priya: thanks all — will follow up with diffs and a tiny repro script we can run locally.
